checked.comment: Matches the paper's BLO definition. The oblivious adversary, losses with |L^T x| <= 1, a convex K with a membership oracle and a known horizon T all agree with the source.
Algorithm 3, 'GeometricHedge with Volumetric Spanners Exploration', is the same algorithm as registry id geometric_hedge_volumetric.
Theorem 7.1: the bound O((s+d) sqrt(T log|K|_{1/T} / d)) and the tuning of eta and gamma are recorded correctly. Regret is the expectation against a fixed x* under an oblivious adversary.
Corollary 7.1, first form: O(sqrt(dT log|K|_{1/T})), stated for an efficient algorithm.
Corollary 7.1, second form: O(d sqrt(T log T)), using log|K|_{1/T} <= d log T.

summary: The extraction is accurate. Theorem 7.1 and both forms of the Corollary 7.1 bound are recorded with the correct expressions, tuning, provenance and setting. The paper's other theorems (1.1, 1.3, 5.1) are convex-geometry results, not bandit guarantees, so leaving them out is correct.
